# reselling_database_db (Resource)

A logical database on a `reselling_database` server. Import with `database_id/db_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_database_db" "shop" {
  database_id = reselling_database.shop.id
  name        = "shop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) Id of the database server.
- `name` (String) Name: starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and underscores (max. 40).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_database_db.shop <database_id>/<db_id>
```
